rationale: The mapping establishes possible zero exits with F and nonzero exits without F. It does not establish that all four flag/F combinations occur. The recorded signal contains no failure-specific outcomes from which those joint occurrences could follow.

signal_basis.exact_text: Subset {a,b} produces that flag on every replay; {a} and {b} do not.
The exit flag pools checkout deadline failures with configuration rejection and early harness termination.
A checkout deadline failure can return a handled response with zero process exit; a nonzero exit can occur before checkout runs.
No target-F trace or result is recorded for any reduced subset; the flag is not a timing bound.
